title: Shakshuka

items: 2 long sweet peppers, seeded + diced or sliced
10 roma tomatoes, skinned + seeded, then chopped, crushed, or pureed. (or 28oz crushed tomato can)

steps: Saute onion, peppers, and garlic in a large 12” pan with olive oil over high heat until translucent or lightly caramelized.
Add the spices, salt, and pepper and cook for 30 seconds longer.
Add the tomatoes and sugar and reduce by half or until desired consistency, approximately 15-20 minutes. You can add water if it reduces too much.
Evenly spaced throughout the sauce, make a small hole and crack an egg into it. Carefully push the sauce over the edge of the egg to help contain it, but do not cover the eggs completely.
Cover the pan with a lid and cook for 5 minutes and 30 seconds. Aim for perfectly poached eggs, where the whites are set on the outside but the yolk is still slightly runny.
Add the garnish: Chopped cilantro gives a fresh bright note. Feta cheese, olives, sausage, or chorizo add a salty note. Honey complements the creamy saltiness from the feta really well.
Serve immediately (before the yolks set) with bread for dipping.
